notes.title: Version 9.9.7 is here
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Following many complaints about low FPS I have made this update to boost FPS as much as possible.
I have added an option called "Boost FPS" in Options->Graphics, this is on by default.
this option works by limiting the texture maps update rate, these include shadows, reflections, refractions, elevation maps etc..

For most cases it will increase FPS by as much as 50%.

Hope you enjoy !

Ilan

notes.title: Version 9.9.6 has been updated with the latest bug fixes
notes.notes:

Enjoy !

Ilan

Thanks,

Ilan

notes.title: Version 9.9.6 is here
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Today I have released version 9.9.6 on Steam, the main changes and updates in this version are:


 Added wave length control for waves options.
 Docking dialog has two modes, anchoring and docking.
 Added viscosity setting for ships.
 Auto zoom turned off for F5 view.
 Fixed overlapping text on main screen.
 Added dgruddr, dgturn instruments.
 Added rudder delay in vehicle.cfg [controls_delay]
 Controls_delay set by ship size unless appears in vehicle.cfg.


I hope you enjoy this version, if there is any problem please email me directly.

Thanks !

Ilan

notes.title: Version 9.9.2 is here
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,


Today I have released version 9.9.2 of Virtual Sailor NG, in this version the following changes were made:
Added Freeze Motion button for freezing a ship while docked.
Saving Freeze state when a ship is docked.
Fixed buttons state on dock dialogs when dock screen attached to panel.
Ctrl+F3,F4 Allowing simulations rates less than 1.
Fixed loading cars onto decks, and saving their positions in situations.
Fixed vehicles positions change when moving from scenery to scenery.
Light sources on ships disappear bug fixed.


As always, please support the development of this program by buying when needed and not using pirated copies...

More updates are coming,

Thanks !

Ilan
